messages:
jamie: Quick check on console observability retention plan — we want to reduce trace retention from 90d -> 30d for dev/staging as a canary (goal: ~40% storage reduction). Who owns the trace-hook audit + dashboard cleanups? Also this depends on the eng-runtime sampling header PR: github.com/redwood/eng-runtime/pull/432

priya: I can own dashboard work (alerts + saved views). Will review the PR but need confirmation we keep span attributes used by error-analysis and reranker.

simon: Eng-runtime PR currently has a failing unit test; I'm on it and should have it green by EOD. Note: this will affect kv-cache keying in some long-tail requests — runtime + obs infra need to sync on migration behavior.

alex: FYI on cost side: switching retention as proposed would drop S3/influx storage costs by ~ $34k/mo. @infra-bot can you publish the updated cost estimate to #finance?

infra-bot: Cost calc posted -> https://redwood.internal/costs/obs-retention-2009999000 — est monthly savings $34.8k, one-time migration ops ~3-4 engineer-days.

jamie: Thanks. @priya can you add a short checklist for dashboard owners (saved views to remove, alert threshold review, owner handoff)? We also need a canary plan: 1) flip dev/staging retention, monitor error-analysis divergence & alert noise for 48h, 2) small prod shard (10%), 3) full rollout. Who volunteers to run the canary runbook?

priya: I will run the canary and pair with simon for runtime rollout. I'll drop the checklist as a comment on the PR.

simon: I'll ping here when the runtime tests are green and when I open the follow-up PR to update /configs/observability.yaml retention labels.

alex: One more quick ask — CODEOWNERS for trace hooks: should be eng-runtime + eng-platform. If we agree I'll file the tiny PR.

jamie: Agreed. Let's add CODEOWNERS entry for /traces/* -> @eng-runtime @eng-platform. Jamie will file PR.

priya: Added @sre-alerts as watchers for threshold changes. Proposed canary date: 2026-04-15 10:00 PT. All good from your sides?

simon: Good for me.

alex: Good here. :thumbsup:

jamie: Great — moving to async follow-ups. I'll post links to the PRs, the canary playbook, and the checklist in this thread when they're ready.
